newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZF to suggest postponing deputy speaker till Feb.
newsitem.headline: NZF to suggest postponing deputy speaker till Feb.

text.p: The New Zealand First Party will move that the election of parliament's deputy speaker be postponed until the house reconvenes in February, deputy leader Tau Henare said.
The opposition wants Labour veteran parliamentarian Jonathan Hunt as deputy to speaker Doug Kidd, while National seeks the position for Ian Revell.
Henare told Reuters it was a caucus decision to seek a postponement until February.
